title: Principal component analysis of wavefunction snapshots in non-equilibrium dynamics
summary: We study non-equilibrium quantum dynamics by performing principal component analysis on the data sets of wavefunction snapshots. We show that a specific transformation of the data sets maximizes the information content in the largest principal component and further enables its connection to certain observables. This connection enables us to explain the dynamical features revealed by such a dimensionality-reduction scheme.
